duster.headline: Diesel-auto stock is thin; 2022 TechRoad Auto best matches criteria, while the 2022 Zen manual is the standout value play.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, R249 900, 47 051 km, +R12 185 — matches every criterion.
2022 Zen diesel manual, R209 990, 72 000 km, +R24 273 — biggest bargain, but manual.
2019 Dynamique Auto diesel, R195 000, 88 500 km, +R5 717 — cheapest diesel auto, pre-2020.

caddy.headline: Single listing: 2020 Crew Bus at R279 990/76 000 km sits under both caps — verify it carefully as the only option.

shortlist.note: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus, R279 990, 76 000 km — only listing, within caps; not suspiciously cheap.

alerts.line: Sole listing — verify service history before deposit

jimny.headline: Only two Jimnys remain under caps after one delisting; 2018 1.3 at R234 890 is cheapest, 2021 GLX near cap.

shortlist.note: 2018 1.3 3-door, R234 890, 86 000 km — cheapest viable; previous-gen model.
2021 1.5 GLX AllGrip 3-door, R295 995, 25 115 km — newest gen, R4 005 under cap.

alerts.line: 28756433 delisted; only two options remain under caps

seltos.headline: Bargains cluster in manual 1.6 EXs; cheapest auto is R210 000 at exactly 100 000 km — negotiate hard on km.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, R210 000, 100 000 km, +R37 692 — cheapest auto; GAC Pinetown for trade-in.
2021 1.6 EX manual, R189 900, 93 800 km, +R44 930 — biggest bargain; Bidvest McCarthy takes trades.
2023 1.6 EX Auto, R274 990, 44 000 km, +R26 946 — newest, low-km auto.

alerts.line: Diesel auto R36 870 over model price — skip

creta.headline: Two new listings; 2021 Premium manual at R199 990 is the standout bargain, 2021 1.6D auto is the diesel match.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.5 Premium manual, R199 990, 81 000 km, +R34 812 — standout bargain; no dealer listed.
2021 1.6D Executive Auto, R249 990, 98 000 km, +R12 454 — diesel auto match; near 100k.
New: 2023 1.5 Executive Auto, R279 900, 77 800 km, +R21 372 — strong value.

alerts.line: 1.5D auto R33 344 over model price — skip

hr-v.headline: Thin market: only two old-gen CVTs; 2021 Comfort at R249,990/57k km is the value pick; no 2022+ hybrid listed.

shortlist.note: 2021 Comfort CVT, R249,990, 57k km — old gen 448L boot + Magic Seats, cheapest; Honda reliability draw.
2020 1.8 Elegance, R298,900, 50k km — R49k dearer and older; only if bigger engine wanted.

alerts.line: No 2022+ hybrid listed; both are 448L old-gen.

corolla-cross.headline: Best value spread of all searches; 2021 XS 36k km sits R28,850 under model — clear buy; verify cheap near-new 2024 Xi.

shortlist.note: 2021 XS, R249,990, 36,300 km, +R28,850 under model — best value, right spec.
2024 Xi, R259,990, 22,294 km, +R18,700 — near-new bargain; verify history first.
2022 Xi, R269,000, 65,855 km, +R10,341 — solid third; base spec.

alerts.line: Near-new 2024 Xi suspiciously cheap — verify service history.

mg-zs.headline: All facelift 443L units; Comfort from R249,900 leads; one R26k price cut this run; 5-yr warranty helps, resale unproven.

shortlist.note: 2026 Comfort, R249,900, 9,906 km, +R13,512 — cheapest facelift, CMH Pinetown.
2026 Luxury, R269,900, 5,000 km, +R17,891 — top value; dealer unstated, verify seller.
2025 Luxury, R259,900, 23,082 km, +R6,132 — higher trim, fair value.

alerts.line: Cut R26,000 to R269,900; 3,568 km, still mid-pack value.

haval-h6.headline: Two 2022 2.0T DCTs under R290k; GWM Hillcrest Premium best Duster-trade candidate; skip the 2019 manual.

shortlist.note: 2022 2.0T Premium, R279,990, 51,300 km — GWM Hillcrest trade-friendly; possible warranty balance.
2025 2.0GDIT Premium, R299,900, 40,000 km — newest, full warranty likely, at cap.
2022 2.0T Luxury, R289,990, 66,100 km — higher spec, higher km, Chery Pinetown.

peugeot-2008.headline: Gen2 autos from R229,990; 2024 Active 30k km best balance of age, km and price; wet-belt proof essential throughout.

shortlist.note: 2024 Active, R239,950, 30,000 km — newest low-km buy, only R10k over cheapest.
2022 Allure, R229,990, 55,000 km — cheapest, higher trim; demand belt history.
2025 Active, R259,950, 32,000 km — near-new fallback at Key Pinetown.

alerts.line: All PureTech 1.2T — demand wet-belt service history.

proton-x70.headline: High-mileage 2022-23 stock, all under R285k with warranty left; best move: CMH Pinetown 2023 Executive AWD R239,900; test wet-DCT in traffic.

shortlist.note: 2023 Exec AWD, 67,000 km, R239,900 — newest at Exec money, beats 2022 twin; AWD suits 4x4 Duster owner; CMH trade.
2023 Standard, 68,100 km, R209,899 — R20,000 under sister Standard, best estUnder after trim adjustment; verify history.
2023 Premium X, 65,300 km, R284,990 — lowest km, top trim; R45k over Executive; non-CMH complicates Duster trade.

alerts.line: R20k under sister unit — inspect history, DCT service.

discovery.headline: Only MG ZS (443 L) clears the 430 L bar; add Omoda C5 restricted to 2025+ X Series (442 L). Others fail or unverified.

shortlist.note: 443 L clears bar; all 6 listings autos, in budget; verify KZN dealer coverage.
Only 2025+ X Series qualifies (442 L); standard C5 is 378 L — filter strictly.
